advancement.servus_manufacturing.journal: Experience is the master. Chapters of the journal, finished by doing alchemy
book.servus_manufacturing.journal.name: Paracelsus' Journal
book.servus_manufacturing.journal.opus.p:
These are the notes of Theophrastus von Hohenheim, who called himself Paracelsus.

I learned from the furnace, the mine and the sickbed, not from old books. Experience is the master. Follow these pages by doing the work, and each chapter of my life will open to you.
book.servus_manufacturing.journal.opus.s:
In the silver mines of Schwaz in Tyrol I worked among the miners and saw the sickness the mountain gives them.

The old miners say that metals grow in the rock like plants, and that small spirits of the earth live in the galleries. If the mountain grows its ores, perhaps it can be asked to.

Salt is the body of all things. Press nine Salt Crystals into a block, eight such blocks into a ring around your Athanor, and its flame turns white: Albedo.

To go on: finish one craft on an Albedo Athanor.
book.servus_manufacturing.journal.opus.v:
Every alchemist needs a furnace that never goes out. Build an Athanor of bricks, a blast furnace and a cauldron. Lay an item on it and feed it principles by bucket or pipe; it burns them into something new.

The stones you set around it decide how far its fire reaches. Alone it burns black, the fire of Nigredo.

My father was a physician in Villach, in Carinthia, a country of mines and smelters. There I first watched ore turn into metal in the fire.

Every body is made of three: Salt, which gives it form, Sulfur, which burns, and Mercury, the spirit that flies off. Burn a thing in the Calciner and the three part from each other. Join them again in the Coagulator.

To finish this chapter:

- Calcine 100 things
- Gather 1,000 mB of Salt
- Coagulate your first Salt Crystal

Your team shares this work. See your progress with /servus_manufacturing journal.
Finishing Villach opens the next chapter of the journal: Schwaz, and the mines.
